items.name: build-your-own-x
items.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
items.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

items.name: llama.cpp
items.summary: Llama.cpp 是一个用 C/C++ 实现的开源项目，专门解决在普通硬件上高效运行大语言模型的难题，让用户无需依赖昂贵的云端计算资源。它通过 GGML 量化技术和优化的 CPU 计算实现高性能推理，展示了如何通过精细的内存管理让数十亿参数模型在本地设备上流畅运行。开发者可以将其集成到桌面应用中，构建本地 AI 助手，或利用其简洁的 C/C++ API 进行自定义模型部署实验，非常适合需要实时文本生成的实际场景。
items.summary_en: Llama.cpp is an open-source C/C++ implementation that enables efficient large language model inference on consumer hardware, solving the challenge of running sophisticated AI without expensive cloud infrastructure. It achieves remarkable performance through GGML's quantization techniques and optimized CPU computation, demonstrating how careful memory management can make billion-parameter models accessible. Developers can integrate it into desktop applications, build local AI assistants, or experiment with custom model deployments using its straightforward C/C++ API for real-time text generation tasks.

items.name: agency-agents
items.summary: Agency-agents是一个开源框架，旨在简化多智能体AI系统的构建。它通过提供预配置的专用智能体，解决协调多样化AI能力的复杂性。每个智能体具有独特的个性和处理流程，支持模块化协作，适用于前端开发、内容审核等特定任务。开发者可通过API快速部署智能体，定制现有智能体以适应新领域，或组合它们构建复杂工作流。该框架适用于自动化多步骤、多专业知识项目，鼓励用户创建智能体团队解决实际问题。
items.summary_en: Agency-agents is an open-source framework that simplifies building multi-agent AI systems by providing pre-configured specialized agents, addressing the complexity of coordinating diverse AI capabilities. Its key insight is structuring agents with distinct personalities and processes, enabling modular collaboration where each agent handles specific tasks like frontend development or content moderation. Developers can deploy these agents via the provided API, customize existing agents for new domains, or combine them to create complex workflows, making it practical for automating multi-step projects requiring varied expertise.

items.name: ai-engineering-from-scratch
items.summary: 这是一个从零开始学习AI工程的开源课程，涵盖大语言模型、AI代理、计算机视觉和MCP等核心领域。其独特之处在于强调通过从零构建项目来深入理解注意力机制、代理架构等关键技术原理，而非仅使用现成库。课程设计循序渐进，适合希望扎实掌握AI工程实践的开发者。你可以按照结构化教程动手实现自己的AI应用，或参与社区贡献，将所学直接应用于实际项目。
items.summary_en: This open-source course teaches AI engineering from fundamentals to deployment, covering LLMs, agents, computer vision, and MCP. It emphasizes building projects from scratch to deepen understanding of core concepts like attention mechanisms and agent architectures. Ideal for developers wanting hands-on experience, you can follow the structured curriculum to create your own AI applications or contribute to the community.

items.name: opentoonz
items.summary: OpenToonz 是一款功能全面的开源 2D 动画制作软件，曾被吉卜力工作室等专业机构用于制作动画电影。它提供了矢量与位图绘制、逐帧动画、合成特效等专业工具，其核心技术亮点在于基于节点的特效工作流和多层摄像机系统，让动画师能灵活控制场景深度与视觉效果。你可以用它从零开始创作手绘动画，或通过插件系统集成到现有制作管线中。对于开发者，其 C++ 代码库是学习动画软件架构的绝佳范例，也欢迎贡献代码改进功能。
items.summary_en: OpenToonz is a full-featured open-source 2D animation software used by studios like Studio Ghibli. It offers professional tools for vector and raster drawing, frame-by-frame animation, and compositing. Technically, it uses a node-based workflow for effects and supports multi-plane camera setups. You can use it to create hand-drawn animations, integrate with other tools via its plugin system, or contribute to its development on GitHub.

items.name: oh-my-pi
items.summary: oh-my-pi 是一款终端 AI 编程代理，旨在简化代码编辑和任务自动化。其核心技术亮点是哈希锚定编辑，通过文件内容的哈希值精确锁定修改位置，确保每次变更可验证、可追溯，避免传统 AI 编辑中的错位问题。它集成了 LSP（语言服务器协议）、Python 解释器、浏览器控制和子代理机制，能处理复杂的多步骤开发流程。基于 TypeScript 和 Rust 构建，支持 Claude、OpenAI 等多种大模型。开发者可在终端中直接使用，完成代码重构、测试运行或编排自动化工作流，显著提升开发效率。
items.summary_en: oh-my-pi is a terminal-based AI coding agent that streamlines code editing and task automation. Its key innovation is hash-anchored edits, ensuring precise, verifiable changes to files. It integrates LSP, Python, browser control, and subagents for complex workflows. Built with TypeScript and Rust, it supports multiple LLM providers like Claude and OpenAI. Developers can use it directly in the terminal to refactor code, run tests, or orchestrate multi-step development tasks, boosting productivity with reliable, AI-assisted automation.

items.name: OpenWA
items.summary: OpenWA 是一个免费开源的 WhatsApp API 网关，允许你自托管 WhatsApp 集成。它提供 RESTful API 来发送和接收消息、管理联系人以及处理 webhook，让你完全掌控数据和隐私。技术上，它采用轻量级 TypeScript 栈，支持多 WhatsApp 实例。你可以将其部署在自己的服务器上，用于构建聊天机器人、自动化客户支持，或将 WhatsApp 集成到业务工作流中，无需依赖第三方服务。
items.summary_en: OpenWA is a free, open-source WhatsApp API gateway that lets you self-host your own WhatsApp integration. It provides a RESTful API to send and receive messages, manage contacts, and handle webhooks, giving you full control over your data and privacy. Technically, it uses a lightweight TypeScript stack and supports multiple WhatsApp instances. You can deploy it on your own server to build chatbots, automate customer support, or integrate WhatsApp into your business workflows without relying on third-party services.

items.name: streambert
items.summary: StreamBert 是一款跨平台的 Electron 桌面应用，让你无广告、无追踪地流媒体播放或下载全球的电影、电视剧和动漫。其技术亮点在于将多个爬虫和流媒体 API 集成到统一的现代化界面中，基于 Electron 和 JavaScript 构建。你可以用它浏览、搜索并即时播放内容，或排队下载以便离线观看。非常适合希望拥有干净、私密媒体中心的断线族和动漫爱好者。
items.summary_en: StreamBert is a cross-platform Electron desktop app that lets you stream or download movies, TV series, and anime from global sources without ads or tracking. Its technical strength lies in integrating multiple scrapers and streaming APIs into a unified, modern UI built with Electron and JavaScript. You can use it to browse, search, and play content instantly or queue downloads for offline viewing. Ideal for cord-cutters and anime fans who want a clean, private media hub.

items.name: bert-base-uncased
items.summary: BERT-base-uncased是一种双向语言理解模型，通过同时分析上下文捕捉完整语义，克服了传统单向模型的局限。其核心技术为掩码语言建模，训练时随机遮盖词汇并预测内容，从而学习深层语言规律。该模型可通过Hugging Face库加载，支持微调实现文本分类或问答功能，也可直接提取词向量用于语义相似度计算，为自然语言处理提供基础能力。

items.name: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2
items.summary: ms-marco-MiniLM-L6-v2是基于BERT的轻量级文本排序模型，专为语义搜索和信息检索优化。通过知识蒸馏技术压缩大型模型的语义理解能力，在保持高精度的同时显著降低计算成本。该模型可应用于智能搜索、文档检索和内容推荐系统，通过编码文本对并计算相似度实现精准语义匹配，尤其适合高效处理海量文本数据的场景。

items.name: electra-base-discriminator
items.summary: ELECTRA-base-discriminator是一种基于判别式预训练的Transformer模型，通过将掩码语言建模改为区分真实与生成器产生的替代标记，显著提升训练效率。其核心创新是使用小型生成器产生替代标记，再由判别器识别真假，比BERT等模型训练更快且性能强劲。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调该模型，应用于文本分类、命名实体识别或问答任务，特别适合计算资源有限但需要高质量语言理解的场景。
